scientific_limitations: The loss probability is fixed strictly between zero and one.
Selection frequencies have a polynomial lower bound and a polynomially vanishing upper bound; the full optimal frequency class is not characterized.
The exponentially rare-coordinate counterexample is an obstruction, not a classification of superpolynomial profiles.
Potential coverage by an equivalent general random-scan rare-hitting theorem remains a priority risk.
